summary:
歐特克上季 EPS 2.85 美元超預期7.8%、營收 19.6 億美元，訂閱與雲端轉型穩健推進。
• EPS 2.85 美元，超預期 7.81%，獲利穩健
• 營收 19.6 億美元，訂閱基本盤扎實
• 雲端與 AI 功能強化平台價值
• AEC 與製造雙引擎布局
ai_view:
訊號正向：EPS 超預期顯示訂閱模式韌性與獲利穩健。短期財報利多支撐股價。中期追蹤新交易模式轉換成效、AEC 與製造需求、自由現金流與營業利潤率擴張。雲端與 AI 功能能否提升 ARPU 為長期成長關鍵。建築景氣與利率為主要週期變數，29倍本益比尚屬合理。

需留意：本期未提供營收年增率，成長能見度有限；建築景氣與利率週期風險；本益比約29倍，估值偏中性偏高

summary_en:
Autodesk beat EPS at $2.85 by 7.8% on $1.96B revenue, with subscriptions and cloud transition advancing steadily.
• EPS of $2.85 beat by 7.81%, solid profitability
• Revenue of $1.96B with a solid subscription base
• Cloud and AI features enhance platform value
• Dual engines in AEC and manufacturing

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: the EPS beat shows subscription resilience and solid profitability. Near term the beat supports the stock. Mid term, track the new transaction model's effectiveness, AEC and manufacturing demand, free cash flow and operating margin expansion. Whether cloud and AI features lift ARPU is the long-term key. Construction cycle and rates are the main swing factors; a ~29x P/E is reasonable.

Watch：Revenue YoY not provided, limiting growth visibility; Construction cycle and interest-rate risk; P/E of ~29x is moderately elevated
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超預期 7.81%，獲利優於估計（營收年增率未提供）。
